C1684.title: Malicious PyPI Package 'perfviewer' Conducts Remote Windows Trojan Implantation
C1684.summary: In November 2025, attackers repeatedly released malicious versions of the PyPI package perfviewer, cloning or copying the legitimate rich package and publishing a malicious PyPI package to induce developer downloads. The package planted a remote trojan during installation and threatened Windows systems. If the exact date of November 24, 2025 is needed, a source proving that date should be added.
